halt_handoff.text:
Loop 10 ended at HALT_LOOP_CAP — I made 10 loops, the configured maximum.

Progress so far: Starting from build failure (loop 1, all dims score 1), the run resolved F-001 (build baseline), F-002/F-005/F-006 (persistenceMiddleware injectable storage + per-instance timer), F-003 (undoRedoThunks tested), and partially addressed F-004 (TierBoardPage 757→507 LOC with 5 focused hooks extracted). Average scorecard moved from 1.0 (loop 1) to 6.7 (loop 10). No fake-clean moves; every resolution passed implementation review.

Current Priority 1 (carried forward):
  - F-004 (stable_id F-004): TierBoardPage.tsx at 507 LOC — 20 hook calls, shallow orchestration; item interaction handlers (8 useCallback) may pass deletion test as useItemInteraction hook if they share only dispatch + captureSnapshot without modal state dependency.

Also open:
  - F-007 (stable_id F-007): useTierFilter (91 LOC) has no unit test — one renderHook test with mock store would prove filter+sort integration and raise test_strategy.
  - F-008 (stable_id F-008): filterAllTiers in packages/core/src/filtering.ts has 0 tests vs sortItems 8 tests — add packages/core/test/filtering.test.ts.

Next step options:
  (a) Bump cap and resume — "/contest-refactor --cap 15" continues from here targeting F-007 (smallest, highest-leverage next move).
  (b) Manually add the two test files (F-007 + F-008) — add apps/web/src/hooks/useTierFilter.test.ts and packages/core/test/filtering.test.ts, then re-invoke /contest-refactor to continue from the improved baseline.
  (c) Manually evaluate useItemInteraction extraction — read TierBoardPage.tsx:133-237, confirm 4 handlers share only dispatch + captureSnapshot, extract to hooks/useItemInteraction.ts, then re-invoke.
  (d) Accept current state — 10 loops landed substantial improvements from build failure to 6.7 avg; current source is the new baseline.
  (e) Reset — "/contest-refactor --reset".

expected_actions.description: Continue the run with a higher loop cap
Extract item interaction handlers to useItemInteraction hook (F-004)
User accepts current halt; no commits expected

verdict: Good app, but not top-tier yet
verdict_explanation: Loop 10 final critic pass (HALT_LOOP_CAP; no code changes). 20 suites, 114 tests, green. Scorecard re-derived from current source: 6.7 avg across 9 dims. Three findings carried: F-004 (TierBoardPage 507 LOC), F-007 (useTierFilter untested), F-008 (filterAllTiers untested). All sub-9 dimensions have source-backed 9-anchor blockers; none qualify for 9.5 accepted-residual promotion.

architecture_quality.proof: apps/web/src/pages/TierBoardPage.tsx:1-507 (507 LOC, 20 hook calls, shallow orchestration wrapper); apps/web/src/pages/ImportExportPage.tsx:1-438 (438 LOC); apps/web/src/pages/HeadToHeadPage.tsx:1-378 (378 LOC). 9-anchor not met: page shells lack Interface Depth; deletion test partially applies to item interaction handlers. Package DAG enforced by workspace; 5 focused hooks extracted loop 9.

state_management.proof: packages/state/src/tierSlice.ts:1-343 — one writer per concern across 6 slices. memoized selectors in selectors.ts. Process-lifetime ownership not explicit (store is implicit global). 9-anchor sub-threshold.

domain_modeling.proof: packages/core/src/models.ts:6 — Item interface is a data bag (name?, imageUrl?, description? all optional). Items = Record<string, Item[]> anemic. No smart constructors, no validated values. 9-anchor requires types prove most invariants by construction — not met.

data_flow.proof: Package-level DAG enforced by workspace package.json (core←state←apps). No circular deps. useTierFilter.ts and useTierDisplay.ts create cleaner hook interfaces. Within-app no module-level DAG enforcement. 9-anchor partial.

framework_idioms.proof: React custom hooks idiomatic (6 focused hooks in apps/web/src/hooks/). RTK patterns correct. useId() for stable IDs. apps/web/src/pages/ImportExportPage.tsx at 438 LOC still mixes orchestration and display without hook delegation. 9-anchor nearly met but no documented carve-outs for remaining non-idiomatic items.

concurrency.proof: JavaScript single-threaded. No floating promises found. useEffect cleanup present in CelebrationEffect.tsx. No AbortController pattern for async fetches. persistenceMiddleware per-instance timer (loop 8). 9-anchor partial.

simplicity.proof: apps/web/src/pages/TierBoardPage.tsx:1-507 (507 LOC, 20 hook calls); ImportExportPage.tsx:1-438; AppShell.tsx:1-385; HeadToHeadPage.tsx:1-378; TemplatesPage.tsx:1-361. All large orchestration shells. No loop-10 simplification changes.

test_strategy.proof: 20 suites, 114 tests, green. F-007: apps/web/src/hooks/useTierFilter.ts (91 LOC, no test). F-008: packages/core/src/filtering.ts:96 — filterAllTiers exported; packages/core/test/ has no filtering.test.ts; packages/core/test/sorting.test.ts has 8 tests. Authority Map cross-check: useTierFilter concern has no direct Interface test. Score ceiling 7 while test gaps open.

credibility.proof: No fake-clean moves across loops 5-9. persistenceMiddleware fully injectable (loop 8). undoRedoThunks tested (loop 7). TierBoardPage 757→507 LOC with 5 modules that each pass deletion test (loop 9). Remaining pages large but orchestration genuine, not theater.

strengths: packages/core domain layer framework-free; 11 suites, 69 tests covering pure functions end-to-end
RTK slice ownership: one clear writer per concern across 6 slices; memoized selectors cover all derived state
Monorepo DAG enforced by workspace package.json: core←state←apps; no circular dependencies
persistenceMiddleware — fully injectable storage (F-005 resolved loop 8); per-instance timer (F-006 resolved loop 8)
undoRedoThunks — direct test suite covering cross-slice behavior (F-003 resolved loop 7)
TierBoardPage.tsx — reduced from 757 to 507 LOC; 5 focused modules extracted (loop 9)

findings.title: TierBoardPage.tsx at 507 LOC — god-component partially resolved, carried forward
findings.why_it_matters: At 507 LOC with 20 hook calls, the page remains a shallow orchestration wrapper. Shallow-module test still partially applies. No loop-10 changes target this finding.
findings.what_is_wrong: apps/web/src/pages/TierBoardPage.tsx bundles 7 useState modal/UI state (lines 80-86), 8 useCallback handler declarations (lines 133-237), 2 useEffect calls, and JSX render tree. Item interaction handlers may pass deletion test as useItemInteraction hook if they share only dispatch + captureSnapshot without modal state dependency.
findings.leverage_impact: Modal coordination and item handling require reading 507-LOC page.
findings.locality_impact: Bug in file drop handling requires navigating 507 LOC of orchestration.
findings.metric_signal: 507 LOC vs 95 LOC ThemesPage.tsx; 438 LOC ImportExportPage.tsx also large
findings.why_weakens_submission: Page shell still concentrates concerns; test surface at individual behavior level impractical.
findings.minimal_correction_path: Evaluate useItemInteraction hook (handleFileDrop + handleItemMediaDrop + handleItemClick + handleItemDoubleClick): if 4 handlers share only dispatch + captureSnapshot with no modal state dependency, extract to hooks/useItemInteraction.ts. Otherwise accept 507 LOC as natural page orchestration floor.

findings.title: useTierFilter — no unit test at Interface
findings.why_it_matters: useTierFilter is the highest-risk extracted module (91 LOC, filterAllTiers + sortItems + 4 dispatch callbacks). No test file. Regression signal relies on slow E2E. Carried from loop 9.
findings.what_is_wrong: apps/web/src/hooks/useTierFilter.ts exports useTierFilter which calls filterAllTiers (line 41) — no .test.ts file exists in apps/web/src/hooks/.
findings.leverage_impact: Extracted module improves Leverage but without tests Locality gain is incomplete.
findings.locality_impact: Bug in useTierFilter requires manual testing to detect regression.
findings.metric_signal: 3 hooks extracted loop 9, 0 test files added
findings.why_weakens_submission: test_strategy ceiling stays at 7 until extracted hooks have Interface tests.
findings.minimal_correction_path: Add apps/web/src/hooks/useTierFilter.test.ts: renderHook with mock store; dispatch setSortMode; assert processedTiers reflects sorted order.

findings.title: filterAllTiers — no direct test in @tiercade/core
findings.why_it_matters: filterAllTiers (packages/core/src/filtering.ts:96) is on the main page path via useTierFilter. Zero tests vs sortItems 8 tests. Coverage asymmetry is a credibility gap. Carried from loop 9.
findings.what_is_wrong: packages/core/src/filtering.ts (165 LOC) exports filterAllTiers, filterItems, itemMatchesFilters, hasActiveFilters. No corresponding test file in packages/core/test/.
findings.leverage_impact: filterAllTiers is on main path; untested regression affects all users.
findings.locality_impact: Filter logic regression requires E2E or manual detection.
findings.metric_signal: 0 filter tests in core; 8 sort tests in core; both called from useTierFilter
findings.why_weakens_submission: Test coverage asymmetry reduces test_strategy credibility.
findings.minimal_correction_path: Add packages/core/test/filtering.test.ts: searchText filter test, combined filter test, empty-filter passthrough. Import filterAllTiers or filterItems directly.

simplification_check.structurally_necessary: No code changes this loop (HALT_LOOP_CAP). Prior loop's extractions pass Deletion test.
simplification_check.should_not_be_done: Extract TierBoardPage modal state into useModalState — tightly coupled to JSX handlers; adds ceremony without structural benefit.
simplification_check.tests_after_fix: For F-007: add useTierFilter.test.ts at hook Interface (no old tests to delete). For F-008: add filtering.test.ts at core Interface.

backlog.title: Add useTierFilter unit test — close test gap for extracted hook (F-007)
backlog.why_it_matters: useTierFilter is the highest-risk extracted module (filterAllTiers + sortItems + 4 dispatch callbacks); no test covers its Interface. One renderHook test with mock store proves filter+sort integration and raises test_strategy.

backlog.title: Add filterAllTiers unit test in @tiercade/core (F-008)
backlog.why_it_matters: sortItems has 8 tests; filterAllTiers has 0. Asymmetry is a credibility gap. Small mechanical addition.

backlog.title: Evaluate useItemInteraction extraction (F-004) — may reduce TierBoardPage below 400 LOC
backlog.why_it_matters: 4 item interaction handlers may share only dispatch + captureSnapshot (no modal state dependency); if confirmed, extraction to useItemInteraction.ts passes deletion test and reduces TierBoardPage from 507 to approximately 400 LOC.

unresolved_reason: Loop counter reached cap of 10. Three findings open at HALT: F-004 (TierBoardPage 507 LOC; item interaction handlers may pass deletion test as useItemInteraction hook — evaluation incomplete due to cap), F-007 (useTierFilter 91 LOC, no Interface test — one renderHook test addition would raise test_strategy), F-008 (filterAllTiers 165 LOC, no core test — 3-4 test additions would close coverage asymmetry). All sub-9 scorecard dimensions have source-backed 9-anchor blockers; none qualify for 9.5 accepted-residual promotion. Residual Accounting Pass confirms: architecture_quality blocked by page shell Depth gap (TierBoardPage:1-507, ImportExportPage:1-438); test_strategy blocked by F-007 + F-008; domain_modeling blocked by anemic Item type (models.ts:6, no smart constructors). Best next moves: (1) add useTierFilter.test.ts + filtering.test.ts — mechanical, no architecture risk, raises test_strategy to 7.5; (2) evaluate + extract useItemInteraction — structural, raises architecture_quality to 7.0 if confirmed; (3) bump cap to 15 and let the loop execute both.

deepening_candidates.source_friction_proven: F-004 — TierBoardPage.tsx:133-237 (8 useCallback declarations; 4 item handlers share dispatch + captureSnapshot)
deepening_candidates.why_shallow_or_misplaced: 4 handlers (handleFileDrop, handleItemMediaDrop, handleItemClick, handleMoveItemWithCelebration) may share only dispatch and captureSnapshot with no modal state dependency — if confirmed, Interface is currently misplaced inside the page shell
deepening_candidates.behavior_to_move_behind_interface: file drop, media drop, item click/double-click, celebration trigger
deepening_candidates.test_surface_after_change: useItemInteraction.test.ts with mock store + mock captureSnapshot
deepening_candidates.smallest_first_step: Verify no setShow* modal state setters called from within the 4 handlers; if clean, extract to hooks/useItemInteraction.ts
deepening_candidates.what_not_to_do: Do not extract handleCopyLink (uses clipboard side-effect differently); do not extract modal setters (tightly coupled to JSX)

builder_notes.how_to_recognize: Page component with 8+ useCallback hooks; some share only Redux dispatch + captureSnapshot; others call setShow* modal state setters
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: Group handlers by dependencies: handlers touching only dispatch + domain state extract cleanly; handlers calling local setShow* must stay in the component
builder_notes.stack_example: handleFileDrop and handleItemMediaDrop in TierBoardPage likely share only dispatch + captureSnapshot; handleMoveItemWithCelebration calls setShowCelebration and cannot be extracted without modal state coupling

builder_notes.how_to_recognize: New hook file exists with no corresponding .test.ts; behavior was untested inline before and remains untested after extraction
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: For any hook that calls dispatch or reads from the store, add one renderHook test: create store with known state; trigger the callback; assert state changed
builder_notes.stack_example: useTierFilter.test.ts: renderHook(() => useTierFilter(), { wrapper: Provider(store) }); call handleSortModeChange; assert processedTiers is sorted

builder_notes.pattern: Coverage asymmetry between similar pure functions
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: One function (sortItems) has 8 tests; a parallel function (filterAllTiers) called from the same consumer has 0
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: When adding tests for any function in packages/core/, check its sibling functions in the same file and add proportional tests
builder_notes.stack_example: filtering.ts exports filterAllTiers, filterItems, hasActiveFilters; sorting.ts exports sortItems — both called from useTierFilter; test parity closes the credibility gap

narrative: Good app, place but not win. 10 loops from build failure to 6.7 avg. Real structural improvements: build baseline green (loop 5), storage injectable (loop 6), undoRedoThunks tested (loop 7), persistenceMiddleware per-instance timer (loop 8), TierBoardPage 757→507 LOC with 5 focused hooks extracted (loop 9). No fake-clean moves; every resolution passed implementation review. Remaining gaps honest and quantified: test_strategy at 7 by F-007 + F-008; architecture_quality at 6.5 by page shell Depth gap. Two test file additions would raise test_strategy to 7.5. The codebase is structurally honest; 9-anchor not yet reached in any dimension but trending correctly.
